name: stage_2_stand_only_no_walking_reward
description: 2026-06-01 — ablation arm of the walking-reward effect study. Identical to picrawler_stand_walk_gated_trot stage 2 EXCEPT: walk_hit_rate=0.0 (legacy radial channel off) AND gated_walk_bonus_rate=0.0 (gated multiplicative bonus off). Standing reward stays at standing_baseline_factor=0.25 × 0.20 = 0.05 hits/tick. Question being tested: does walking reward have ANY causal effect on brain behavior, given that the demo run showed walking_rate=0.000 hits/tick (gate never crossed)? If this ablation produces bit-identical behavior to the control arm, walking reward is decorative; if not, there's a sub-threshold influence worth understanding. The user's concern: radial metrics will reward any straight motion from origin, so background drift could be inflating the measured "walking" contribution.
